rules.title: Sicurre API unavailable
rules.summary: The Sicurre API has not been scrapeable for two minutes.
rules.runbook: Check the sicurre-api container, Neon connectivity, and /health before restarting.

rules.title: Sicurre elevated 5xx rate
rules.summary: More than 2% of Sicurre gateway responses are server errors.
rules.runbook: Use the application dashboard and traces to identify the failing surface before rollback.

rules.title: Sicurre latency above SLO
rules.summary: Sicurre gateway p95 latency has exceeded five seconds.
rules.runbook: Compare app, API, and auth latency before changing capacity or dependencies.

rules.title: Sicurre telemetry collector unavailable
rules.summary: The Sicurre Alloy collector has not been scrapeable for two minutes.
rules.runbook: Inspect Alloy configuration, remote-write credentials, and container health.

rules.title: Sicurre controlled operational exercise
rules.summary: An owner-approved synthetic monitoring exercise is active.
rules.runbook: Confirm the exercise ID in the Sicurre admin console and wait for automatic recovery.

rules.title: Sicurre active-series budget above 70%
rules.summary: The shared Sicurre telemetry footprint exceeds 70% of the 10,000-series free-tier allocation.
rules.runbook: Review scrape_samples_scraped and per-job cardinality before adding metrics or labels.

rules.title: Sicurre active-series budget above 85%
rules.summary: The shared Sicurre telemetry footprint exceeds 85% of the 10,000-series free-tier allocation.
rules.runbook: Freeze new telemetry labels and reduce the highest-cardinality scrape before the tenant limit is reached.
